Name: No More Pile of Bugmeat
Author: AirynS
Description:
A simple mod, this changes the giant wobbling pile of bugmeat in Willy's "Juicy Bugs Wanted!" special order event into a comically-oversized giant bucket of bugmeat instead.

To install, just extract the "[CP] No More Pile of Bugmeat" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.
